questions.question: What CSS function sets responsive min, ideal, and max values?
questions.explanation: clamp constrains values between minimum and maximum.

questions.question: What media feature targets high-resolution displays?
questions.explanation: resolution media queries detect pixel density.

questions.question: What container query feature adapts to parent size?
questions.explanation: Container queries respond to parent element dimensions.

questions.question: What property creates responsive aspect ratios?
questions.explanation: aspect-ratio maintains proportions across sizes.

questions.question: What Grid value repeats columns responsively?
questions.explanation: repeat generates responsive grid patterns.

questions.question: What unit adapts to smallest viewport dimension?
questions.explanation: vmin uses the smaller of vw or vh.

questions.question: What unit adapts to largest viewport dimension?
questions.explanation: vmax uses the larger of vw or vh.

questions.question: What property optimizes image loading per device?
questions.explanation: srcset provides different images for different screens.

questions.question: What HTML element enables responsive images?
questions.explanation: picture element serves different image sources.

questions.question: What media query logic combines multiple conditions?
questions.explanation: and operator chains media query conditions.

questions.question: What property must a parent set so children can use container queries?
questions.explanation: container-type establishes a containment context.

questions.question: What property assigns a name for targeted container queries?
questions.explanation: container-name labels specific query containers.

questions.question: What container query unit is relative to the container's inline size?
questions.explanation: 1cqi equals 1% of the container's inline size.

questions.question: What media feature detects users requesting minimal animation?
questions.explanation: prefers-reduced-motion respects accessibility settings.

questions.question: What viewport height unit adapts as mobile browser toolbars show or hide?
questions.explanation: dvh tracks the dynamic viewport height.

questions.question: A site's nav collapses into a three-line icon whose menu slides in from the edge on phones. Name this navigation pattern.
questions.explanation: The hamburger menu hides navigation behind a three-bar icon, revealing it as an overlay or slide-in panel.

questions.question: A developer writes base styles for phones, then adds `@media (min-width: 768px)` layers for larger screens. Which responsive philosophy is this?
questions.explanation: Mobile-first starts with small-screen styles and progressively enhances via min-width media queries.

questions.question: At exactly 1024px a layout jumps from two columns to three via a media query. What is the 1024px point called?
questions.explanation: A breakpoint is the viewport width at which a media query changes the layout.

questions.question: A designer prefers `svh` over `vh` so a hero section never hides behind mobile browser toolbars. What does svh size to?
questions.explanation: svh equals 1% of the small viewport height, which assumes browser UI is fully expanded.

questions.question: A UX team serves dark-theme styles automatically when the OS is in dark mode. Which media feature detects that preference?
questions.explanation: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) matches when the user requests a dark color scheme.
